source: 앞 대화는 이전 DB 조회 결과. 추가 세 턴은 실제 iOS 화면과 기기 도구 출력에서 그대로 옮겼다. 새 DB 조회 결과가 아니다.

parts.text:
다음 날 아침, 어제 그 카페 계산대다.
아이스 아메리카노를 시키고 카드를 댔는데 두 번이나 거절됐다.
지갑 속 현금은 눈으로 봐도 조금 모자란다.
Oh, hi again. Hmm, it still says declined. Do you have another card?
Sorry, I have a meeting in ten minutes. Is this going to take long?
I have no other card. Can I pay with my phone? Owen, I am sorry for the wait.
Yes, you can pay with your phone. Please open your payment app and tap it here.
That is okay. Please try your phone.
Before I pay, do you remember how I wanted my coffee yesterday?
Yes. You wanted your iced Americano with only a little ice yesterday. I remember.
That sounds good, but please pay with your phone now. I really need to go.

observedTurns.user: Owen, I know you are in a hurry. Can you wait one more minute, or do you need to go now?

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.text: I can wait one more minute. Please try your phone now.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Thanks, Owen. Your drink is ready, but I still need the payment first.

observedTurns.user: Mia, I have opened my payment app, but I have not tapped yet. Where should I hold my phone? Owen, thanks for waiting.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Hold the top of your phone over the small reader here. You will hear a beep.

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.text: No problem. I can wait while you pay.

observedTurns.user: Mia, I have tapped my phone and heard the beep. Did the payment go through? Owen, thank you for giving me a minute.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: Yes, it went through. Here is your iced Americano with only a little ice.

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.text: Good. I am glad it worked. I hope you make your meeting.

observedEnding.outcome: 휴대폰 결제에 성공하고 어제와 같은 아이스 아메리카노를 받았다
